Move it out of hot midday sun or behind a sheer curtain. Damaged patches won't recover, but new leaves will be fine.

problems.symptom: Fine pale speckling and webbing under leaves
problems.cause: Red spider mite, worse in warm, dry air
problems.fix: Shower the leaves, raise humidity and isolate the plant. Predatory mites work well for stubborn outbreaks.

problems.symptom: White fluffy blobs in leaf joints and sticky leaves
problems.fix: Isolate the plant and wipe them off with a damp cotton bud. Check again weekly, as eggs hatch later.

source.name: RHS Urban Show: low-light tolerant houseplants
